Professional Summary

Software engineer with 8+ years building backend microservices, REST APIs and developer frameworks in Java, Python and Go, nearly five of them working asynchronously with teams across Europe and the US. At Oracle, I added HTTP and gRPC tracing to Micronaut and integrated Kubernetes workload identity with Oracle Cloud. At Seven Bridges, I worked on usage-based billing and built a Go service for sharing credentials through Vault.
Experience
Oracle — Principal Data Systems Software Engineer (IC4)
Promoted from Senior Software Engineer (IC3) to Principal (IC4) in June 2024 · Micronaut and GraalVM · Belgrade, Serbia

Contributed 400+ merged pull requests across the Micronaut ecosystem (including AI-assisted and AI-generated work), reviewed <link href="https://github.com/search?q=org%3Amicronaut-projects+is%3Apublic+reviewed-by%3An0tl3ss+-author%3An0tl3ss+is%3Apr+is%3Amerged&type=pullrequests" color="#124c43"><u>300+ pull requests</u></link> from other contributors, and published releases for <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-sql/releases/tag/v7.1.3" color="#124c43"><u>Micronaut SQL</u></link>, <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-data/releases/tag/v5.1.5" color="#124c43"><u>Data</u></link>, <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-tracing/releases/tag/v5.0.2" color="#124c43"><u>Tracing</u></link> and <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-oracle-cloud/releases/tag/v5.8.2" color="#124c43"><u>Oracle Cloud</u></link>.
Observability and framework integrations

Instrumented Micronaut <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-tracing/pull/65" color="#124c43"><u>HTTP and gRPC</u></link> clients and servers with OpenTelemetry spans, tracing annotations and SDK configuration. Added integration tests and documentation.

Added database tracing for <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-tracing/pull/646" color="#124c43"><u>JDBC</u></link> and <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-tracing/pull/863" color="#124c43"><u>R2DBC</u></link>, integrated <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-micrometer/pull/585" color="#124c43"><u>Micrometer Observation</u></link>, and added support for the <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-micrometer/pull/848" color="#124c43"><u>Prometheus Pushgateway</u></link>.
Added annotations for service names and per-endpoint HTTP metric dimensions. Extended a reference service’s Grafana dashboard with worker metrics and workflow queue depth.
Cloud SDKs and service reliability

Built <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-aws/pull/1438" color="#124c43"><u>AWS CloudWatch logging</u></link> and OCI integrations: logging, <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-oracle-cloud/pull/596" color="#124c43"><u>certificate management and reloading</u></link>, <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-oracle-cloud/pull/686" color="#124c43"><u>OKE workload identity</u></link> and configurable signing-proxy requests.

Fixed an <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-oracle-cloud/pull/1402" color="#124c43"><u>OCI retry</u></link> path that could block a Netty event loop after a read timeout. Regression tests check server responsiveness during backoff and preserve the original timeout cause.
Extended OpenAPI code generation in Gradle to support OCI Java SDK v3 clients alongside Micronaut clients. Added SDK v2 and v3 client modules to a reference application.
Micronaut Data vector search (AI-assisted)

Implemented dense and sparse vector types, derived similarity queries, scoring and schema generation, with Oracle and PostgreSQL vector indexes (<link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-data/pull/3637" color="#124c43"><u>PR #3637</u></link>, <link href="https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-data/latest/guide/#sqlVectorType" color="#124c43"><u>documentation</u></link>).
Added JDBC integrations for Oracle Database, PostgreSQL (pgvector) and MySQL HeatWave, plus Oracle and PostgreSQL R2DBC, with Java, Kotlin and Groovy tests and examples.
Python interoperability and native developer tooling

Adapted Python coroutines to reactive Java publishers in Micronaut. Contributed fully AI-generated <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13786" color="#124c43"><u>dataclass introspection</u></link> with typed validation annotations.

Extended <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/pyronaut/pull/397" color="#124c43"><u>Pyronaut packaging</u></link> to include Python runtime dependencies in Docker images, fat JARs and wheels. Added async pytest support and multi-architecture containers.
Added tested Python OAuth2/OIDC samples for Auth0, Keycloak and Amazon Cognito, plus CORS, token propagation, async HTTP clients and Oracle Database integrations.

Fixed <link href="https://github.com/graalvm/native-build-tools/pull/589" color="#124c43"><u>Maven/Docker native-image builds</u></link>, <link href="https://github.com/graalvm/native-build-tools/pull/590" color="#124c43"><u>resource-configuration scanning</u></link> and <link href="https://github.com/graalvm/native-build-tools/pull/781" color="#124c43"><u>JUnit compatibility</u></link> in GraalVM Native Build Tools; contributed <link href="https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/pull/215" color="#124c43"><u>OpenTelemetry reachability metadata</u></link> and tests.
Java migrations and release engineering
Built and tested OpenRewrite recipes for JDK 25 across Maven and Gradle builds, CI toolchains and container images. Upgraded two reference services to JDK 25.
Built a release pipeline that checked change approvals, verified generated templates with a canary and Maven, and restored release tags if validation failed.
Oracle · Developer guides and delivery tooling

Authored Micronaut Guides on Kubernetes (<link href="https://guides.micronaut.io/micronaut-k8s-oci-gradle-java/" color="#124c43"><u>Oracle OKE</u></link>, <link href="https://guides.micronaut.io/micronaut-k8s-aws-gradle-java/" color="#124c43"><u>Amazon EKS</u></link>, <link href="https://guides.micronaut.io/micronaut-k8s-gcp-gradle-java/" color="#124c43"><u>Google GKE</u></link>) and metrics (<link href="https://guides.micronaut.io/micronaut-metrics-aws-gradle-java/" color="#124c43"><u>AWS CloudWatch</u></link>, <link href="https://guides.micronaut.io/micronaut-metrics-oci-gradle-java/" color="#124c43"><u>Oracle Cloud</u></link>); co-authored <link href="https://guides.micronaut.io/micronaut-cloud-trace-oci-gradle-java/" color="#124c43"><u>OCI OpenTelemetry tracing</u></link>.

Extended <link href="https://graal.cloud/gdk/" color="#124c43"><u>Graal Development Kit</u></link> application and Kubernetes generation across AWS, OCI and GCP. Added <link href="https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-starter/pull/1302" color="#124c43"><u>OCI DevOps project generation</u></link> and CI checks for generated applications.
Routed JDBC tests from OCI Build to GitLab CI, where Testcontainers and Micronaut Test Resources could start test databases. Linked the pipeline to the pull request for the exact commit tested.

Added native checks and parallel Maven and Gradle smoke tests for API, worker, data-access and canary modules. Automated weekly updates and major/minor branch sync. Verified offline builds with a local mirror.

Platform infrastructure and backend services in Java, Python and Go

Split pricing and charging into Java services. Charging consumed egress events from RabbitMQ and applied customer-specific rates in near real time. Pricing notified charging when a cached rate card changed. Built the billing administration gateway and Go HTTP clients.
Built a secrets management service in Go with HashiCorp Vault, allowing users to store sensitive credentials and organization administrators to share secrets with authorized members.

Built the MFA service in Python from scratch and integrated it across the platform. Users could choose TOTP or email verification and regain access with recovery codes. Improved OAuth2 single sign-on for Java and Python applications.
Implemented a Go service that monitors AWS EC2 test environments and shuts them down after 90 minutes without user activity.
Developed a Go and MongoDB messaging service for administrative announcements to anonymous users, registered users or individual recipients.
